clue.text: Chesterton's man's offspring one who has far to go?

definitions.text: one who has far to go?

parts.note: G. K. Chesterton wrote The Man Who Was Thursday, so his man is Thursday, here in the possessive
a child is someone's offspring

explanation.surface: A question about the son of one of Chesterton's characters, and whether he faces a long journey.
explanation.walkthrough: The nursery rhyme 'Monday's Child' says 'Thursday's child has far to go', which is why the definition carries a question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: In the old fortune-telling rhyme, the infant born on that weekday is fated to travel a long way.

clue.text: Confection delivered by European or Asian transport?

parts.note: Turkey straddles Europe and Asia, so something from there is both
transport in the sense of rapture or great joy

explanation.surface: A sweet seems to arrive by some continental vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transport' looks like a vehicle but means ecstasy; Turkey lies partly in Europe and partly in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a gel sweet dusted with sugar, a classic sugary confection.

clue.text: None of Jones's animals were different

definitions.meaning: in Orwell's Animal Farm the beasts that overthrow the farmer Mr Jones declare that all animals are equal, so none of them is otherwise
not the same in size or amount

explanation.surface: A claim that every beast on Mr Jones's farm was alike.
explanation.walkthrough: Mr Jones is the farmer driven out in Orwell's Animal Farm, whose rebels proclaim that all animals are equal.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that differ in measure or status are not on a par with each other.

clue.text: Find an explanation for only accepting five

indicators.note: accepting means the word for only takes the next piece inside itself

parts.note: sole means only, as in sole survivor
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Explaining something only by taking in the number five.
explanation.definitionFit: To work out a puzzle or problem is to arrive at its answer or explanation.

clue.text: Came in as confused as a forgetful person

indicators.note: confused tells us the letters of the preceding words are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone walks in as muddled as a person who cannot remember things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' scrambles CAME IN AS; the second 'as' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone suffering memory loss is forgetful by definition.

clue.text: Plant called upon to provide an opening for Ali Baba

definitions.meaning: an oil-seed herb grown in warm countries

definitions.text: called upon to provide an opening for Ali Baba
definitions.meaning: in the tale, the magic words 'open ...!' unseal the robbers' cave for Ali Baba

explanation.surface: A herb invoked to open the cave in the Arabian Nights story.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a seed-bearing herb and the password in the famous command that opens the thieves' cave.

clue.text: Conventional cloak with fringe

parts.note: to hide something is to cloak it
a bound is a boundary or edge, so a fringe

explanation.surface: A traditional garment trimmed with a border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cloak' and 'fringe' read as nouns of dress, but cloak is the verb to hide and fringe means a boundary.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow-minded person stuck in traditional ways is rigidly old-fashioned.

clue.text: Brilliantly playing elegy, absorbing bishop

indicators.note: absorbing means the word for elegy takes the next piece into its middle

parts.note: a lament is a mournful poem or song, an elegy
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: Someone performing a funeral song excellently while taking in a churchman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' seems to belong with elegy as a performance, but it is part of the definition: a flame playing over a surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes light flickering softly and radiantly over something, like a flame dancing.

clue.text: Like the controlled journeys of a couple of Vikings

definitions.text: Like the controlled journeys of a couple of Vikings

parts.words: Like the controlled journeys of a couple of Vikings
parts.note: Viking 1 and Viking 2 were NASA probes guided across space to Mars in the 1970s, not Norse raiders

explanation.surface: Norse seafarers on carefully directed voyages.
explanation.walkthrough: The Vikings are not raiders in longships but the two American spacecraft sent to Mars in 1975.
explanation.definitionFit: Missions between Earth and Mars travel through space from one world to another.

clue.text: Mouldings incorporating fifty little birds

indicators.note: incorporating means the mouldings word takes the next piece into its body

parts.note: reedings are decorative convex mouldings like a row of reeds
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Decorative plasterwork containing fifty small birds.
explanation.walkthrough: Reeding is an architectural term for parallel convex mouldings.
explanation.definitionFit: These are bearded tits, small birds of reed beds.

clue.text: Skilful performer? The devil he is!

definitions.meaning: an expert, as in a ... at chess
the devil himself, an evil spirit

explanation.surface: Someone marvels at a gifted performer and exclaims about him.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a fiend and, informally, someone remarkably good at something.

clue.text: Get accustomed to being rejected in tougher unions

indicators.note: being rejected means the run of letters is turned back to front
in means the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Learning to live with rebuffs from hard-line trade unions.
explanation.walkthrough: Inside 'tougheR UNIons' lies ERUNI, which 'being rejected' turns round; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To harden someone to something unpleasant is to make them used to it.

clue.text: House key always must be put back, note

parts.note: a semi is a semi-detached house, a common British home type
B is a musical key

indicators.note: must be put back means the word for always is written in reverse

parts.note: ever means always

explanation.surface: A rule that the house key must always be returned, with a reminder note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'note' looks like a written message but is a musical note.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a whole note in music, a long time value.

clue.text: Macho type left manuscript inside for course controller

indicators.note: inside means the following pieces go within the macho word

parts.note: a he-man is a strong, macho man

explanation.surface: A tough guy leaves a manuscript behind for someone steering a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' suggests a race or meal but means a ship's heading.
explanation.definitionFit: The one at a ship's wheel steers and controls its course.

clue.text: Provide information about vessel shown in drawing

indicators.note: about means the informing word surrounds the vessel

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing to the police
a ketch is a two-masted sailing boat

explanation.surface: Giving details about a ship pictured in a sketch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shown in' is a link joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Making rough pencil pictures is the act of drawing.

clue.text: Ram vehicle in front, leading to quarrel

indicators.note: in front means the vehicle goes ahead of the ram

parts.note: a bus is a vehicle
tup is a dialect word for a ram

explanation.surface: A car rams the vehicle ahead, which starts an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ram' looks like a verb of collision but is the male sheep, TUP.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisy falling-out is a row or argument.

clue.text: Offhand, but an artist made him laugh!

definitions.meaning: Frans Hals painted the famous portrait The Laughing ...

explanation.surface: A painter is said to have made a casual fellow laugh.
explanation.walkthrough: The Laughing Cavalier is a 1624 portrait by Frans Hals in the Wallace Collection.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means haughtily careless, and is also a Royalist gentleman like the one in Hals's portrait.

clue.text: Sign English doctor found by the French motorway

parts.note: MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine
le is French for the
M is the British abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1

explanation.surface: An English GP and a French driver are spotted by the motorway, beside a road sign.
explanation.definitionFit: A badge or symbol is a sign standing for something.

clue.text: They are nomads, i.e. bound to go wandering

indicators.note: to go wandering signals that the letters roam into a new order

parts.note: the abbreviation i.e. supplies its letters I and E

explanation.surface: Nomads, that is, people destined to keep roaming.
explanation.definitionFit: Arab desert tribes traditionally move from place to place with their herds.

clue.text: Plant needing special drainage

indicators.note: special suggests the letters are arranged in a particular new way

explanation.surface: A shrub that requires particular soil drainage.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a fragrant white-flowered shrub, a garden plant.

clue.text: Like immediate neighbours, live in snug retreat

indicators.note: in means the living word goes inside the retreat

parts.note: a nest is a cosy hideaway
are means exist or live, as in we are

explanation.surface: Next-door people living in a cosy hideaway.
explanation.definitionFit: Those immediately adjoining are closest of all.

clue.text: Something very hard to remove from rocks like mine?

definitions.text: Something very hard to remove from rocks like mine?

parts.words: Something very hard to remove from rocks like mine?
parts.note: a shellfish clamped to rocks gave its name to a magnetic mine stuck to a ship's hull

explanation.surface: A stubborn thing clinging to rocks, perhaps in a quarry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mine' looks like a possessive or a pit, but it is an explosive: a limpet mine clings to its target.
explanation.definitionFit: This shellfish clings to rocks famously tightly, and a sticky explosive device shares its name.

clue.text: Mate attending trendy function in part of Asia

indicators.note: attending means the mate word follows along after the other pieces

parts.note: in means fashionable
a do is a party or function
china is Cockney rhyming slang for mate (china plate)

explanation.surface: A friend accompanying someone to a fashionable party in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: In Cockney rhyming slang 'china plate' means mate.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Southeast Asian peninsula of Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia.

clue.text: Sweetheart making us lose our temper

definitions.meaning: to flare up in anger, as when online posts provoke fury

explanation.surface: A lover who drives us to fury.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a lover and also to blaze up in rage.

clue.text: Plants I'd removed from the Sunshine State

indicators.note: removed means the following letters are taken out of the state name

parts.note: the Sunshine State is the nickname of Florida
I'd gives its letters I and D

explanation.surface: Greenery that someone has dug up from Florida.
explanation.definitionFit: The collective term for a region's vegetation covers all its plants.

clue.text: Alluring woman, one arriving on time

indicators.note: arriving on means the one comes after the time word

parts.note: an hour is a unit of time
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A seductive woman who turns up punctually.
explanation.definitionFit: In Islamic tradition these are beautiful maidens of paradise, hence a voluptuous beauty.

clue.text: One appearing in dreadful hole with lamp — Nightingale?

indicators.note: appearing in means one goes within the scrambled letters
dreadful indicates the following letters are rearranged badly

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A figure in a horrid hole holding a lamp, like Florence Nightingale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadful' rearranges the fodder into PHLOMELA and 'appearing in' slips I after the H. The lamp hints at Florence Nightingale, but in Greek myth Philomela became the songbird.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend this princess was transformed into the songbird, so her name poetically denotes it.

clue.text: Chivalrous behaviour of man coming in to protect royal artist

parts.note: a knight is a man in chess

indicators.note: to protect means the entering word wraps round the next pieces

parts.note: entry is the act of coming in
R stands for rex or regina, royal
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A man entering to shield a royal painter, the very model of chivalry.
explanation.definitionFit: The roving deeds of medieval champions were the epitome of gallant conduct.
